VALUE In Progress 1.6 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This project involves the development of a luxury resort on the North Coast, featuring 141 villas and 172 buildings designed to the highest standards. Reviewing design drawings, monitoring work progress, overseeing the project schedule and cash flow, and ensuring quality and HSE compliance for Eagle Hills Properties and CIB. BECT's scope included tender documents, site supervision and project management.
